as_told.title: Grusch's documents to IC Inspector General Monheim

plain: In 2022, the story goes, David Grusch, a former intelligence officer, handed hundreds of pages of documents to the ICIG, the internal watchdog of the US spy agencies, laying out a long-running secret program that recovered crashed UFOs. Michels tells it many times. He says the inspector general at the time, Thomas Monheim, called the claims 'urgent and credible.' In one episode he puts the count at over a thousand pages, and elsewhere he calls the number 'presumed.' In another he tells it secondhand through someone named Omar, saying Grusch had hundreds of pages on a crash retrieval program running 'Sub Rosa,' meaning in secret. The online researcher UAPGerb says it may have been a thousand pages or more and complains that Monheim has since left and nothing has been done with them. To the tellers, it shows Grusch's claims were taken seriously by an official watchdog.
